Pulso summary
Checks the quota whenever Android allows the widget to update. Keeps the last reading offline.
Codex, Copilot and Claude are checked whenever Android allows the widget to update. The last reading is kept offline and the refresh button requests a new one without opening Pulso.

Credential stored encrypted on this phone

Enterprise: the monthly limit comes from GitHub. If unavailable, the fallback limit is used. Personal: a token with Plan → read permission and a manual included quota. The token is stored encrypted; leave it empty to keep it.
Live activity · Ongoing notification
Provider in the notification

Optional: shows one provider as an ongoing notification, visible on the lock screen, with its percentage and renewal. It changes only when PULSO receives a reading; it does not query quotas every minute in the background. It lasts at most 8 hours and Android or you may dismiss it earlier. Then you must start it again. The provider and its figures are visible without unlocking; no accounts or credentials are shown.
Notifications are turned off for PULSO. Turn them on in Settings to receive the alert.
Open notification settings
Keeps the screen on while PULSO is open. For a desk display: connect the phone to a charger, rotate it to landscape and add the PULSO widgets. Android controls how often widgets update.
Battery saver
Battery optimization
Android has not woken PULSO yet

Android decides when it runs the request, and never more often than every 15 minutes; Doze and battery saver can delay it further. Widgets can query Codex, Copilot and Claude with the phone locked, using the encrypted storage shared with PULSO, and keep the last reading if a query fails. Claude uses its experimental web session: if it expires or asks for a check, open its session in PULSO. No interval is guaranteed.

Google does not support this embedded browser. Use email access. This step is not native OAuth: it keeps the current web session. When the quota is queried, its session is stored encrypted so widgets can refresh. Disconnecting Claude removes that copy. You confirm codes, CAPTCHAs and any authorization on claude.ai.
